title: Modern North of Nashville Retreat-Easy Lake Access
description:
Located just 30 minutes north of Nashville, we offer the perfect balance of peaceful suburban living and easy access to the vibrant city life. Located in a quiet neighborhood by the lake, our property offers all the modern amenities you need for a comfortable stay. Plenty of driveway space for boat parking. With a fully equipped kitchen, and cozy bedrooms, you will feel right at home from the moment you arrive. Fiber internet and smart TVs in all rooms. Cable included. Easy access to boat ramps.

The space
Renovated from head to toe! Smart TVs available in every room with access to all streaming services and YouTube TV with 100+ channels. High speed Fiber internet is also available.

Other things to note
Plenty of room for multiple vehicles and boat parking. 1 mile to nearest boat ramp! Only 30 minutes away from Nashville. This is centrally located in Gallatin, TN with easy access to many restaurants and things to do. This is a duplex, so an additional unit can be booked if available. This would sleep a total of 12 guests. 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 6 beds.
